name: copilot-sidecar-companion
description: Non-replacing remote companion (Copilot Lazy Ass) for GitHub Copilot Chat: mirror chatSessions over WebSocket/PWA and inject prompts via workbench chat commands.

commands.title: Copilot Lazy Ass: Copy PWA URL
Copilot Lazy Ass: Show QR Panel
Copilot Lazy Ass: Copy Auth Token

copilotSidecar.host.description: Bind host. Use 127.0.0.1 for local-only; 0.0.0.0 for LAN.

copilotSidecar.autoStart.description: Start bridge when VS Code finishes startup.

copilotSidecar.authToken.description: Optional shared token. If set, clients must send PHONE_CONNECT.token (or ?token= on PWA URL).

copilotSidecar.defaultMode.description: Default chat mode for injected phone messages.

copilotSidecar.injectSessionOpen.description: Inject targeting. 'editor' (default, commercial): open target chat session as ChatEditor then submit; require disk verify or clipboard. 'sidebar': also Move Chat into Side Bar (may refocus wrong widget on 1.131). 'focused-only': paid-Remote parity, may hit wrong session.

copilotSidecar.pollMs.description: JSONL tail poll interval in ms (Remote uses 8; 50 is gentler).

copilotSidecar.sessionRescanMs.description: How often to rescan for newest chatSessions jsonl.

copilotSidecar.liveOnly.description: If true, start tailing at EOF (only new chat activity). If false, replay whole session on switch.

copilotSidecar.preferTranscript.description: Use GitHub.copilot-chat/transcripts realtime event stream as primary content source (millisecond latency, avoids chatSessions ~60s state flush lag). Falls back to chatSessions when transcripts dir missing.

copilotSidecar.enableTunnel.description: Auto-start Cloudflare quick tunnel when bridge starts. If false (default), open sidebar and click「开启隧道」or run command Start Tunnel. Public URL and session token only appear after tunnel starts.

copilotSidecar.downloadCloudflared.description: If cloudflared is missing, download once into ~/.copilot-sidecar-companion/.

copilotSidecar.tunnelTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for cloudflared trycloudflare public URL before failing Start Tunnel.

scripts.test:e2e:fast: npm run compile && SKIP_TUNNEL_SMOKE=1 node scripts/e2e_local.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run compile && node scripts/test_chatcontrol.mjs && node scripts/test_workspaceindex.mjs && node scripts/test_portscan.mjs && node scripts/test_sessionperf.mjs && node scripts/test_dispatch_isolated.mjs && node scripts/test_pin.mjs && node scripts/test_sessionselect.mjs && node scripts/test_bighistory.mjs && node scripts/test_gapfill_pending.mjs && node scripts/test_transcript_order.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && SKIP_TUNNEL_SMOKE=1 node scripts/e2e_local.mjs
scripts.test:vscode: npm run compile && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/run_vscode_tests.mjs
